text: 2 tier good in reality, factor in the cost of a microfiber pad and a lot of unused space. Two-tier dish drainer sound really good until you realize you need a microfiber pad underneath and they're always good in reality but in use the single ones are much better they're definitely space-saving but given a chance I would go back to Walmart and just buy your basic Rubbermaid dish drainer if not because it's easy to clean and the silverware container part is bigger Plus again it's practical to look at but in actual use it's a real pain with a lot of space you can't use or water drips from the rack to the bottom and factor in the cost of a microfiber pad that needs to be laundered periodically,
